variants.name: plain
variants.note: use_exits=False, rebalance=paper.REBALANCE_EVERY, next-open fills, nothing else

variants.name: live
variants.note: the full live execution policy: market_pit_scorecard._live_options

variants.name: live-block_overbought
variants.note: live without the band gate on buys

variants.name: live-exit_at_close
variants.note: live with sells at the open instead of the close; deferred_buys is dropped too because simulate.run refuses it without exit_at_close, so this variant measures both together

variants.name: live-green_day_skip
variants.note: live without holding a sell back on a green open

variants.name: live-live_midcycle
variants.note: live without the mid-cycle band entries

variants.name: live-deferred_buys
variants.note: live without the deferred buy leg

variants.name: live-event
variants.note: live without the FOMC exposure path and lifecycle

variants.name: plain+exit_at_close
variants.note: plain fills with sells at the close

variants.name: plain+event
variants.note: plain fills with the FOMC exposure path and lifecycle

note: Every variant is one registered trial, fixed in VARIANTS before the run. Lines priced on identical sessions from each of the first `offsets` sessions of the restricted report with policy_v4's allocator; medians and worsts are across offsets; paired statistics at the median offset against plain and against live.

verdict.text: 2016-2023 at 25 bp: plain 27.5% against live 23.2% (gap +4.3 pt). Single removals: live-block_overbought +0.1 pt (t +0.10) KEEP; live-exit_at_close -0.8 pt (t -1.78) KEEP; live-green_day_skip -0.4 pt (t -0.91) KEEP; live-live_midcycle +4.5 pt (t +0.50) KEEP; live-deferred_buys -0.1 pt (t +0.17) KEEP; live-event +0.0 pt (t n/a) KEEP. Reconstruction: single removals sum to +3.4 pt against the +4.3 pt gap (interaction +0.9 pt). No removal clears 1 pt with t >= 2 and not worse on 2024-2026; every option is KEEP.
